title: ValueError: min() iterable argument is empty - 4.70 regression
body:
tqdm 4.70.0, Python 3.13.11, darwin

For repro.py:

```
import tqdm, sys
print(tqdm.__version__, sys.version, sys.platform)
from tqdm.contrib.concurrent import thread_map

def work(x):
    return x * 2

# A generator has no known length -> length_hint(...) == -1.
items = (i for i in range(10))

thread_map(work, items)
```

`uv run --with tqdm==4.70 repro.py` fails with:

```
4.70.0 3.13.11 (main, Jan 14 2026, 23:14:53) [Clang 21.1.4 ] darwin
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "repro.py", line 73, in <module>
    thread_map(work, items)
    ~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "uv/environments-v2/repro-0e60a7ad04e84e4d/lib/python3.13/site-packages/tqdm/contrib/concurrent.py", line 191, in thread_map
    return _executor_map(ThreadPoolExecutor, fn, *iterables, **tqdm_kwargs)
  File "uv/environments-v2/repro-0e60a7ad04e84e4d/lib/python3.13/site-packages/tqdm/contrib/concurrent.py", line 127, in _executor_map
    kwargs['total'] = _min_map_len(iterables)
                      ~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "uv/environments-v2/repro-0e60a7ad04e84e4d/lib/python3.13/site-packages/tqdm/contrib/concurrent.py", line 104, in _min_map_len
    return min(n for it in iterables if (n := length_hint(it, -1)) >= 0)
ValueError: min() iterable argument is empty
```

`uv run --with "tqdm==4.69.1" repro.py` works:
```
4.69.1 3.13.11 (main, Jan 14 2026, 23:14:53) [Clang 21.1.4 ] darwin
10it [00:00, 169125.16it/s]
```
